A FEW PRACTICAL DETAILS

Before we begin.

Who is GoPlan designed for?＋

Incoming students who have been admitted and matriculated but have not started their degree are the priority. Students can return to their saved plan as their studies progress.

What can students use today?＋

The AUI prototype supports academic direction, course choices, opportunities, semester planning, saved roadmaps, progress and Excel export. Other university editions will be prepared with their data during an agreed pilot.

Does it replace academic advising?＋

GoPlan supports student reflection and planning. Registration, credit recognition, course availability and individual academic approvals still need confirmation with the university.

How does student access work?＋

The public AUI demo accepts any email. Verify it once, create your GoPlan password and start planning. University pilots can use an approved student cohort.

What does the proposed price cover?＋

The calculator estimates a one-time price per student for your selected roadmaps, AI edits in each guided stage and global changes per completed roadmap. Each roadmap includes five initial stages. The estimate follows projected usage with a 25% usage buffer, then a 20% markup. Hosting, support, academic data preparation and other operating costs are agreed in the final university quote. The public demo does not collect payments.

How does the current demo differ from the university offer?＋

The free AUI demo currently includes one roadmap, two AI edit prompts per stage and five global changes after saving. The calculator lets universities explore different proposed allowances. A pilot’s final agreed package is configured separately. Manual editing and Excel export continue after the included AI changes in both.

How are recommendations prepared?＋

GoPlan combines reviewed academic information with AI matching. Its planning rules check prerequisites, credits and semester placement. More complex requests use a generative model, and explicit research requests can refresh public-source evidence. Students review the resulting plan and confirm official decisions with their university.

What will a pilot help us learn?＋

Whether newcomers use and return to their plans, where recommendations need improvement, and what the university needs from the service. Traction and impact will be reported after measurement.
